name: Yuzuno Aika
source:
A tomboyish girl from the swimming club. Wears a sport swimsuit to swim. Fast swimmer but has trouble gasping breaths, swallowing water instead sometimes. She has to pee frequently because of that.

She's popular among girls because of her easy-going personality.

"My body feels weird recently, I'm unable to hold my pee till the toilet."
